# @vercel/cli-support

The JavaScript build of [Vercel CLI](https://vercel.com/docs/cli). Install
[`vercel`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vercel), not this package.

`vercel` installs this package and runs it where its native binary can't run:
on operating systems and CPUs without one, and as a fallback when the native
binary can't be installed, downloaded or started. It has no `bin` of its own.

The source lives in
[`internals/cli-core`](https://github.com/vercel/vercel/tree/main/internals/cli-core).
